LESSON: KUANDIKA 2.3.1 INSHA ZA KIUAMILIFU BARUA YA KIRAFIKI

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: KISWAHILI
Strand: Strand 2
Topic 2.3: Kuandika 2.3.1 Insha za Kiuamilifu Barua ya kirafiki

SEHEMU 1: KARIBU

Habari! Leo ni somo la kusoma: Kuandika 2.3.1 Insha za Kiuamilifu Barua ya kirafiki. Soma maelezo, fuata mifano iliyofanyiwa kazi, kisha fanya mazoezi.

SEHEMU 2: MALENGO

Mwisho wa somo hili, utaweza:

1. explain what Kuandika 2.3.1 Insha za Kiuamilifu Barua ya kirafiki means in simple pupil language
2. give 3 correct examples of Kuandika 2.3.1 Insha za Kiuamilifu Barua ya kirafiki from Kenya
3. practise Kuandika 2.3.1 Insha za Kiuamilifu Barua ya kirafiki in clear steps
4. apply Kuandika 2.3.1 Insha za Kiuamilifu Barua ya kirafiki in one real-life situation this week

SEHEMU 3: SOMO (MAELEZO NA MIFANO)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: KUANDIKA 2.3.1 INSHA ZA KIUAMILIFU BARUA YA KIRAFIKI
Subject: KISWAHILI · Grade: Grade 9
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Kuandika 2.3.1 Insha za Kiuamilifu Barua ya kirafiki helps you succeed in KISWAHILI. You will understand it, practise it, and use it nyumbani, shuleni, na sokoni.

KEY FACTS: KUANDIKA 2.3.1 INSHA ZA KIUAMILIFU BARUA YA KIRAFIKI
Study Kuandika 2.3.1 Insha za Kiuamilifu Barua ya kirafiki like a learner textbook page: meaning → examples → practice → check.
Replace teacher words with your own words.
If a step is unclear, rewrite it shorter and try again.

PART 1: Explain what Kuandika 2.3.1 Insha za Kiuamilifu Barua ya kirafiki means in simple pupil language

What this means
In this part you learn to explain what Kuandika 2.3.1 Insha za Kiuamilifu Barua ya kirafiki means in simple pupil language. You will use ideas from nyumbani, shuleni, na sokoni.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: explain what Kuandika 2.3.1 Insha za Kiuamilifu Barua ya kirafiki means in simple pupil language.
2. Soma, sema, kisha andika using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Mfano wa kusoma: Soma sentensi fupi kuhusu “Kuandika 2.3.1 Insha za Kiuamilifu Barua ya kirafiki”, kisha eleza kwa maneno yako.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can explain what Kuandika 2.3.1 Insha za Kiuamilifu Barua ya kirafiki means in simple pupil language. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: Give 3 correct examples of Kuandika 2.3.1 Insha za Kiuamilifu Barua ya kirafiki from Kenya

What this means
In this part you learn to give 3 correct examples of Kuandika 2.3.1 Insha za Kiuamilifu Barua ya kirafiki from Kenya. You will use ideas from nyumbani, shuleni, na sokoni.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: give 3 correct examples of Kuandika 2.3.1 Insha za Kiuamilifu Barua ya kirafiki from Kenya.
2. Soma, sema, kisha andika using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Mfano wa kuzungumza: Zungumza na rafiki kwa dakika 1 kuhusu Kuandika 2.3.1 Insha za Kiuamilifu Barua ya kirafiki.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can give 3 correct examples of Kuandika 2.3.1 Insha za Kiuamilifu Barua ya kirafiki from Kenya. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 3: Practise Kuandika 2.3.1 Insha za Kiuamilifu Barua ya kirafiki in clear steps

What this means
In this part you learn to practise Kuandika 2.3.1 Insha za Kiuamilifu Barua ya kirafiki in clear steps. You will use ideas from nyumbani, shuleni, na sokoni.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: practise Kuandika 2.3.1 Insha za Kiuamilifu Barua ya kirafiki in clear steps.
2. Soma, sema, kisha andika using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Mfano wa kuandika: Andika sentensi 3 sahihi kuhusu Kuandika 2.3.1 Insha za Kiuamilifu Barua ya kirafiki.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can practise Kuandika 2.3.1 Insha za Kiuamilifu Barua ya kirafiki in clear steps. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 4: Apply Kuandika 2.3.1 Insha za Kiuamilifu Barua ya kirafiki in one real-life situation this week

What this means
In this part you learn to apply Kuandika 2.3.1 Insha za Kiuamilifu Barua ya kirafiki in one real-life situation this week. You will use ideas from nyumbani, shuleni, na sokoni.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: apply Kuandika 2.3.1 Insha za Kiuamilifu Barua ya kirafiki in one real-life situation this week.
2. Soma, sema, kisha andika using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Mfano wa kusoma: Soma sentensi fupi kuhusu “Kuandika 2.3.1 Insha za Kiuamilifu Barua ya kirafiki”, kisha eleza kwa maneno yako.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can apply Kuandika 2.3.1 Insha za Kiuamilifu Barua ya kirafiki in one real-life situation this week. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Kuandika 2.3.1 Insha za Kiuamilifu Barua ya kirafiki is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SEHEMU 4: MIFANO YA HARAKA

Example 1: Soma sentensi fupi kuhusu “Kuandika 2.3.1 Insha za Kiuamilifu Barua ya kirafiki”, kisha eleza kwa maneno yako. (skill: explain what Kuandika 2.3.1 Insha za Kiuamilifu Barua ya kirafiki means in simple pupil language)

Example 2: Zungumza na rafiki kwa dakika 1 kuhusu Kuandika 2.3.1 Insha za Kiuamilifu Barua ya kirafiki. (skill: give 3 correct examples of Kuandika 2.3.1 Insha za Kiuamilifu Barua ya kirafiki from Kenya)

Example 3: Andika sentensi 3 sahihi kuhusu Kuandika 2.3.1 Insha za Kiuamilifu Barua ya kirafiki. (skill: practise Kuandika 2.3.1 Insha za Kiuamilifu Barua ya kirafiki in clear steps)

Example 4: Soma sentensi fupi kuhusu “Kuandika 2.3.1 Insha za Kiuamilifu Barua ya kirafiki”, kisha eleza kwa maneno yako. (skill: apply Kuandika 2.3.1 Insha za Kiuamilifu Barua ya kirafiki in one real-life situation this week)

SEHEMU 5: MAZOEZI

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Kuandika 2.3.1 Insha za Kiuamilifu Barua ya kirafiki to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: explain what Kuandika 2.3.1 Insha za Kiuamilifu Barua ya kirafiki means in simple pupil language.
3. Practise this skill: give 3 correct examples of Kuandika 2.3.1 Insha za Kiuamilifu Barua ya kirafiki from Kenya.
4. Practise this skill: practise Kuandika 2.3.1 Insha za Kiuamilifu Barua ya kirafiki in clear steps.
5. Make one local Kenya example of Kuandika 2.3.1 Insha za Kiuamilifu Barua ya kirafiki from your county, market, farm, or school.
6. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SEHEMU 6: KAZI YA NYUMBANI

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Kuandika 2.3.1 Insha za Kiuamilifu Barua ya kirafiki: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 9 learner study Kuandika 2.3.1 Insha za Kiuamilifu Barua ya kirafiki?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SEHEMU: KUMBUKA

1. Know what Kuandika 2.3.1 Insha za Kiuamilifu Barua ya kirafiki means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: explain what Kuandika 2.3.1 Insha za Kiuamilifu Barua ya kirafiki means in simple pupil language.
5. Be able to: give 3 correct examples of Kuandika 2.3.1 Insha za Kiuamilifu Barua ya kirafiki from Kenya.

Sasa fanya Jaribio la Marekebisho. Angalia Majibu baada tu ya kumaliza.
